Money.description: Total list amount for this level. null for usage.

productId.description: Product id for a specific version of the product. Must have the same root as the parent Item.

startDate.description: Absolute start date. Absolute date when scheduled is true, otherwise calculated.

endDate.description: Inclusive absolute end date. Absolute date when scheduled is true, otherwise null.

scheduled.description: Indicates schedule has explicitly scheduled dates.

quantity.description: Portion of ItemSchedule quantity assigned to this level. null for usage

ItemScheduleLevelRequest.description: Level price and discount info. Required for tiered products.

id.description: ID used to reference an existing schedule in bulk requests.

productId.description: Product id for a specific version of the product. Must have the same root as the parent Item.

startIndex.description: Start at regular payment index. Used for relative dates to the start date.

endIndex.description: Inclusive end at regular payment index. Used for relative dates to the start date.

discount.description: Indicates whether the price should be considered a discount. May not be true if price is higher than listPrice.

levels.description: Level price and discount info. Required for tiered products.
